verdict.rationale: Morph documents serving open-weight chat models, including Kimi K3 through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Nothing in the evidence describes how quickly it adds newly released open-weight models, such as a day-zero launch policy, a release cadence or a model changelog. Hosting some open-weight models is related to the story but does not show timely availability of new releases.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
